document_title: What Happens During Processing - Step by Step User Experience
description: This describes exactly what you see on screen while your book is being converted

preflight_summary.what_you_see: A summary box showing all your settings before processing begins
preflight_summary.what_you_are_asked: 'Everything look good? (y) to start, (n) to go back:'
preflight_summary.if_you_say_no: You go back to change settings

connection_test.when_this_happens: Only if you selected Edge-TTS (online voice)
if_connection_fails: 'Would you like to switch to Piper (offline)? (y/n)'

intro_creation.what_is_happening: The program creates an audio clip with your channel's intro (the text from config about 'Yo legends, welcome back to the channel...')

chapter_processing_sequential.when_this_mode_is_used: When you chose 'one at a time' processing

what_happens_next.if_using_edge_tts: '   ⚡ Switching to Piper for this chapter...'
what_happens_next.if_retry_fails: '   ⚠️ Skipping Chapter 3 after 3 attempts. Moving to next chapter.'

chapter_processing_concurrent.when_this_mode_is_used: When you chose 'multiple at once' processing
chapter_processing_concurrent.what_you_see: A progress bar that fills up as chapters complete

what_the_numbers_mean.time: How long it has been running

thumbnail_generation.what_is_happening: The cover image from your EPUB is being resized and enhanced with text overlay

text_overlay_options.if_text_overlay_enabled: The book title and chapter range are added to the image

subtitle_generation.when_this_happens: Only if subtitles are enabled in your settings

what_you_see: '   Loading Whisper AI model (this may take 30 seconds first time)...'
transcription_process.progress_display: A progress bar shows transcription progress

if_whisper_not_installed.what_you_see: '⚠️ Whisper not available. Using simple timestamp-based subtitles instead.'
if_whisper_not_installed.difference: Subtitles will show chapter titles only, not word-by-word captions

video_rendering.progress_display: A percentage counter that updates every few seconds

chapter_markers.when_this_happens: Only if chapter markers are enabled
chapter_markers.what_this_does: YouTube will automatically show chapter timestamps in the video player

what_you_see: 📁 Output folder: Novels/Active Novels/The Uzumaki Legend/output/

notification_sound.what_happens: Your computer plays a notification sound to alert you that processing is done
notification_sound.if_processing_failed: A different alarm sound plays to get your attention

options_shown: 1. Process more chapters from this book

video_file.what_it_contains: The cover image displayed for the entire video, with your audio playing and subtitles appearing

audio_file.what_it_contains: Just the audio without video, in case you want an audiobook-only version

subtitle_file.what_it_contains: All the subtitles in a separate file
subtitle_file.use_case: Upload to YouTube for auto-captions, or for accessibility

what_it_contains: Auto-generated hashtags based on detected fandoms
youtube_description.how_to_use: Copy and paste this into YouTube's description box
